column1: # Each number may FALL freely.  Raising one requires editing this
# file, and editing this file is where the defect gets written.

column3: DISCHARGED 2026-08-20. The v0.5 spellings were migrated to the v0.9 pin across 41 modules (commit "Cubical lane: finish the v0.5 -> v0.9 migration"): `solve` -> `solve!` / `solveℕ!` with per-call-site argument introduction, `·Rid` -> `·IdR`, `Symmetric-Group` -> `SymGroup`. No statement changed. Each of the 41 was run individually under Agda 2.8.0 + cubical v0.9, LC_ALL=C.UTF-8: 41 exit 0, previously 41 exit 42. SubgroupIndex.agda, which this metric did not count and whose cause was the newly-ambiguous `⟪_⟫`, is green too and carried four further defects showing it had never typechecked at all -- see its commit message. A rise above 0 means a module was written against a library this tree is not pinned to.

the assumed one is ExclusionRecoversGroundAtAPrice:267 (isSet T with Discrete T), already documented by NaturalMachine/HypothesesAssumedWhereTheyAreDerivable; the rest are DERIVED at their sites (LinearOrderFinite from isFinSet, StagewiseComposite says so in its header) and are ratchet noise, not findings.
truncation is often the honest move; this number exists so a new one cannot be added without someone writing why.
set-truncation assumes UIP at the object; each of these should be able to say what higher structure it destroys.
